data.name: Fiesta Americana Monterrey Pabellón M
data.address: Av. Benito Juárez 1102, Pabellón M, 64000 Monterrey, N.L., Mexico
data.description:
In a high-rise tower of the Pabellón M multipurpose building, this upscale hotel is an 11-minute walk from the Museum of Contemporary Art in Monterrey, and 8 km from the Alfa Planetarium.
Contemporary rooms offer free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, as well as minibars and coffeemakers. Suites add separate living areas. Room service is available.
Amenities include a sleek restaurant with a terrace and a bar, as well as a spa, a rooftop pool and fitness facilities.
